name: EasyCV Autonomous Automation Loop
description: Complete automation pipeline for EasyCV: OCR code review, LLM refactoring, TDD auto-fix, worktree isolation, per-file commits, and continuous integration
author: fource

requires: Git (for worktree and plumbing merge operations)

commands.full_loop_with_frontend: uv run python -m automation loop --limit 10 --target backend/ && uv run python -m automation loop --limit 50 --target web/
commands.refine_backend: uv run python -m automation refine --target backend/ --limit 10
commands.refine_frontend: uv run python -m automation refine --target web/ --limit 50
commands.refine_automation: uv run python -m automation refine --target automation/ --limit 15
